summary: [spec-fidelity] CHANGELOG row of SUBJECT_ADOPT_REFUSED correctly does NOT list SUBJECT_CONFLICT; the brief text (lines 62, 71, 109, 125) lags, not canon. Checked: before the split (c0e7c7b89^) SUBJECT_ADOPT_REFUSED was emitted by adopt_change and by the unadopt precondition lookups only for a missing subject, a missing change and a failed read/write, never for a conflict; those are now SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND, CHANGE_NOT_FOUND, WRITE_*, REPO_* as the row says. The conflicts of unadopt (approved brief, @flow-tagged scenario) were SUBJECT_UNADOPT_REFUSED, whose row already lists SUBJECT_CONFLICT with APPROVED_BRIEF and FLOW_TAGGED (CHANGELOG line 178), and I confirmed subject.rs:589 answers SUBJECT_CONFLICT/APPROVED_BRIEF. subject adopt has no conflict condition (an already adopted change is an idempotent no-op), so SUBJECT_CONFLICT on the adopt row would be false. atip.codesplit.10 encodes this (SPLIT has no new code for SUBJECT_ADOPT_REFUSED) and its Then step says so. Action: planner should correct the approved brief text; no code change. Blast radius: scripts that branch on SUBJECT_CONFLICT only see unadopt and subject move TRANSITION refusals.
